prompts.name: 낡은 판자촌
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: standalone high-resolution stage 1 headquarters illustration for a Korean organization strategy game. Input image 1 is the existing organization concept sheet; edit target is ONLY the leftmost headquarters panel in its middle row (the old shantytown), not the full sheet. Primary request: recreate that exact small panel as one crisp richly detailed standalone landscape game environment, preserving its existing building identity, composition, scale and night mood. Show the cluster of humble Korean hillside shacks with weathered overlapping corrugated roofs, wood and rusty sheet-metal walls, narrow dirt passage, the small warmly lit right-side doorway and hillside homes behind. Same slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Keep the organization progression's lowest humble level. Rich navy-black shadows and warm amber practical lighting, premium cinematic realistic environment painting. Output one coherent full-bleed landscape image at highest available resolution around 1536x1024 or larger; architectural edges, roof seams, concrete and wood details must be sharp and clear without blur, mist veil or heavy bokeh. Do not upscale the full contact sheet. Exclude all text, Korean letters, names, numbers, panel dividers, arrows, borders, labels, watermarks, logos, characters and weapons. Preserve original source separately; this is a new high-resolution derivative.
